messages:
eric: FYI deploy-bot tripped on a tail-latency spike for /chat in na-east after 2.9.0. It suggests a rollback candidate but auto-revert is set to ON for this window.
deploy-bot: deploybot:signal: region=na-east route=/chat metric=p95 threshold_exceeded for 5m. recommendation: MANUAL_ROLLBACK preferred (staged). auto_revert: ON (will revert in 15m unless locked). confidence=low-medium.
sam: we have a customer change window in 30m. auto revert could cause churn. Can someone flip the auto-revert to OFF and run a manual staged pin?
ops-eng: on it. Proposed small plan: 3% -> 20% -> 100%, 4m soak each. We'll also enable an automated smoke eval between steps.
audrey: quick probe on logs shows latency tail with kernel=vectorfast; errors unchanged. snippet: `2026-04-05T09:05:02Z p95=512ms kernel=vectorfast route=/chat`.
eric: thanks. I'm going to add a HOLD to prevent auto-revert: `deployctl hold-auto-revert --id 2026-04-05-290 --region na-east --reason "partner change window"`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: auto_revert_hold set id=2026-04-05-290 status=ack
ml-oncall: pinged. note: new attention split in v2.9 has higher tail for some long-context prompts; might be related. happy to run quick kernel patch if staged pin doesn't stabilize.
ops-eng: executing 3% pin to previous flag: `infractl pin --route /chat --version 2.8.7 --region na-east --slice 3 --reason "p95 tail"`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1799502468-1
audrey: kicking off smoke eval set "chat_tail_smoke" now. will run blocking check on p95 and token drop.
ops-eng: 3% stable after 4m. p95 improved ~45%. proceeding to 20%.
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1799502468-2
ml-oncall: eval passed for quality and latency on the smoke set. no regressions observed.
sam: posting a short internal status for product: "Staged manual rollback in na-east for /chat due to increased tail latency after 2.9.0. Auto-revert held to avoid customer churn. Monitoring continuing."
ops-eng: ramping to 100% now: `infractl pin --route /chat --version 2.8.7 --region na-east --slice 100 --reason "staged mitigation of p95 tail"`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1799502468-3
audrey: final checks green. p95 back to baseline, errors flat.
eric: publishing release-note amendment: add line to 2.9.0 notes: "Mitigated a p95 tail regression by reverting kernel selection flag in na-east; postmortem to follow."
ml-oncall: follow-up actions: add long-context tail tests to preflight, and flag this kernel selector for slower rollout cadence.
sam: created ticket INF-2026-499 to track postmortem and release note updates. closing thread after ticket created.
deploy-bot: deploybot:signal: pin_job completed id=pin-1799502468-3 status=success
